acceptance: On a scratch host outside the repo, runtime and cycle cells, pinned versions of qmd, CodeGraph and graphify run with telemetry off against the same gold query sets and the code-index truth sets.
A table of recall@5, MRR (knowledge base) and precision, recall, top-1 and p50/p95 latency (code) for each tool beside our own rankers is added to the two research dossiers.
No route, policy or dependency of the pipeline changes; adoption stays a separate operator decision.
fix: Run the external comparators on a scratch host only and record the measured numbers in the dossiers.
source: operator decision 2026-11-23 (comparator runs allowed on a scratch host only)
summary: The qmd and code-intelligence dossiers rest on vendor numbers for qmd, CodeGraph and graphify. The operator allowed benchmark-only runs of those tools on a scratch host, so their claims can be measured against our gold sets and truth sets.
title: External code and knowledge tools are measured on a scratch host against our gold sets
